items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Pete Johnson and myself, we got a job at Ethel Waters's nightclub.

ctx.x: I used to remember they had a fellow called Clarence Rand. That was before Bing Crosby's time, and he used to had a theme song, and I used to like the way he sing his theme song so I learned it. But now it slips my mind what the name of it was. And I used to listen to the radio and listen to all that music on the radio, and we had a wind-up Victrola at my house, and we had some records of all the old-time singers and stuff, and one record that I liked was Ethel Waters. She was singing on a record, "Shoo Shoo…
